<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sa_pattern"><sa_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><ci_type>x_1044869_tomek_0_cmdb_ci_u_custom_web_app</ci_type><cpattern_type>1</cpattern_type><description/><directory>false</directory><enforce_proc_classy>false</enforce_proc_classy><invoke_per_account>false</invoke_per_account><metadata_id>64b0483cc3b632101cae1933e401319d</metadata_id><name>Custome Apache Web App on Docker</name><ndl>pattern {
	metadata {
		id = "64b0483cc3b632101cae1933e401319d"
		name = "Custome Apache Web App on Docker"
		description = ""
		citype = "x_1044869_tomek_0_cmdb_ci_u_custom_web_app"
	}
	identification {
		name = "Custom Web App on Docker"
		entry_point {type = "*"}
		find_process_strategy {strategy = LISTENING_PORT}
		step {
			name = "Match process"
			match {
				contains {
					get_attr {"process.executable"}
					"php"
				}
				terminate_op = terminate
				terminate_msg = ""
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Send command to Apache"
			runcmd_to_var {
				cmd = "apachectl -S 2>/dev/null"
				execution_mode = "DEFAULT"
				var_names = "app1info"
				parsing_strategy = delimited_parsing {
					include_lines_pattern = "namevhost"
					exclude_lines_pattern = "default"
					selected_positions = 1
				}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
				cache_flag = 0
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Parse command output"
			parse_var_to_var {
				from_var_name = "app1info"
				to_var_names = table {
					name = "x_1044869_tomek_0_cmdb_ci_u_custom_web_app"
					col_names = "u_vhost_name","u_config_file"
				}
				parsing_strategy = regex_parsing {regex = "port\\s+80\\s+namevhost\\s+([^\\s]+)\\s+\\(([^:]+):"}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
			}
		}
	}
}
